items.action: Add `@include bp.emit-vars;` once, beside your a-la-carte `@use` of `styles/breakpoints`, in exactly one global stylesheet.
items.appliesWhen: Only if you took the 0.4.0 advice and imported `styles/breakpoints` a la carte. The `styles/ds` aggregate already includes emit-vars once, so its users need nothing.
items.pitfall: Sass still compiles clean, which is what makes this quiet: `$bp-*` and the `up()` / `down()` mixins come from the plain `@use` and keep working, so every media query is fine. What disappears is the runtime mirror — anything reading `var(--bp-md)` from CSS or through getComputedStyle now reads nothing.
items.note: The partial is side-effect-free on a plain `@use` now: it carries the map, the `$bp-*` aliases and the mixins, and emits no CSS. The `--bp-*` custom properties come only from `emit-vars`, which is meant to run once per document.

items.action: Build after upgrading, then rename your own member or mark it `override` wherever the compiler reports a collision with a class in `detect`. Delete an override of a member the class lost.
items.appliesWhen: Only a class that extends one of the classes in `detect`. A consumer who uses the elements in templates needs nothing from this item.
items.pitfall: `private` and `protected` give no protection: a member you redeclare collides with a base member of any visibility. A member of yours that replaced a lost one no longer replaces anything, and the component stops calling it.
items.note: `BottomSheetComponent` gained `closeFallbackTimer`, `finishClose` and `ngOnDestroy`. `DrawerComponent` and `ModalComponent` each gained `closeFallbackTimer` and `finishClose`. `DatePickerComponent` gained 7 and lost `caretAfterDigits`, `ghostRemainder`, `removeDigit` and `writeBack`.
items.verify: The app builds with no error naming a class listed in `detect`, and every member of such a subclass that shares a base member's name is marked `override`.

informational: .grid-2/.grid-3/.grid-4 layout utils now collapse to 1 column below 640px ($bp-sm) — visual only, no code change.
.t-mono-block gains max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto — long lines scroll instead of overflowing the page, no code change.
ds-modal panel clamps max-width to calc(100vw - var(--space-6)) and max-height to 90dvh (the existing 90vh stays as fallback) at every width - visual only, no code change.
New `menu` (hamburger) icon added to the icon registry — additive.
ds-description-list item grid tracks now use minmax(0, …) and the value gains overflow-wrap: anywhere, fixing page-wide horizontal scroll caused by long unbroken values — visual only, no code change.

ds-drawer/ds-bottom-sheet/ds-modal teardown no longer hangs (scrim stuck, body scroll locked) when the tab is backgrounded mid-close — each now arms a 300ms synthetic-fallback timer alongside the animationend listener so teardown completes even if Chrome freezes the leave animation; no code change required from consumers.

ds-popover overlay now reserves an 8px viewport margin (FlexibleConnectedPositionStrategy.withViewportMargin(8)) — panels no longer touch or cross the screen edge on small viewports; visual only, no code change.

ds-date-picker calendar panel caps to calc(100vw - var(--space-4)) and stacks the presets column below the day grid below 640px ($bp-sm), replacing the fixed 454px-wide side-by-side layout that overflowed phone viewports — visual only, no code change.
.grid-3/.grid-4 layout-utils collapse tiers normalized to canonical breakpoints: 1100px -> 1024px ($bp-lg), 820px -> 768px ($bp-md) — visual only, no code change.
ds-page-header actions full-width threshold normalized to canonical breakpoint: 720px -> 768px ($bp-md) — visual only, no code change.

ds-date-picker text entry is now segment-aware — typing/Backspace/Delete stay within the focused MM/DD/YYYY field (single and range mode) instead of shifting digits across the separators and moving the caret; behavior only, no code change.

ds-date-picker now shows per-segment placeholders (each empty MM/DD/YYYY segment renders its own format letters, partial segments show digits + muted padding) via a transparent input over a per-slot overlay, keeping the value fixed-width and the caret aligned — visual/behavior only, no code change.

ds-date-picker calendar panel is now non-blocking (hasBackdrop: false) — it closes on outside pointer-down but the trigger stays live (clicking the icon while open toggles it closed) and hover/pointer events reach the rest of the page; behavior only, no code change.
ds-date-picker no longer shows a __/__/____ mask residue or raises a false invalid state on blur when the field is pristine (single and range mode) — behavior only, no code change.
ds-date-picker paste is now slot-aware — pasted digits fill segments sequentially from the caret instead of flattening the field or clearing unrelated segments; behavior only, no code change.

ds-date-picker range values can no longer be corrupted by clearing one segment (slot-based parsing replaced digit-count slicing; a date is parsed/validated only once all its slots are filled) — behavior only, no code change.
ds-date-picker now exposes its MM/DD/YYYY format hint to screen readers via aria-placeholder after the native placeholder was removed for the overlay rework — a11y only, no code change.
